paragraphs: Rav Shmuel, the brother of R' Berevyah: Jerusalem Orlah, beginning of chapter 2. In the same matter in Jerusalem Sheloshah she-Akhelu, end of mishnah 1, “R' Shimon, Rav's brother” is a scribal error. At the end of Ha-Oreg and in Af al Pi, halakhah 3: R' Shmuel, Rav's brother. In chapter 8 of Terumot, “Shmuel son of R' Berekhiah vowed” is a scribal error; it should read “Rav's brother.” R' Gamliel Zuga reports in his name: Orlah, there.
